name: Short ads
description: Use when making a short ad or promo: one message, the product clear in the first seconds, variants for each length and shape, and an end card with the offer. Claims only from the brief.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.
